segments.title: Yokosuka as a naval town and museum stop
segments.body: The museum visited near Yokosuka's naval base includes displays about the industrial period. Individual exhibits are not identified in the narration. The town leaves a strong impression of its connection to the navy. A fuller visit to Mikasa is planned for the following day.

evidence.note: The transcript places the museum by the naval base, mentions industrial-period displays, and describes Yokosuka as a navy town.

segments.summary: A brief museum visit near Yokosuka's naval base notes industrial-period displays and the town's naval character.
